issue_log.handled: Raw column kept with NaN + missing flag; `interest_rate_pct_filled` uses the loan-type median for analytics; the model pipeline imputes on the training fold only
issue_log.why: Rate is a pricing field that depends mostly on product; loan-type median preserves that structure
issue_log.impact: Imputed rows have slightly understated rate dispersion; 2% of rows, so immaterial

issue_log.found: 7293 loans (49.7%) originated before the customer relationship start date
issue_log.handled: Both dates kept; a flag column records the inconsistency; relationship tenure is NOT used as a model feature
issue_log.why: Cannot tell which date is wrong; a tenure feature derived from them would be meaningless for half the book
issue_log.impact: Loses a potentially useful 'relationship length' feature; raised as open question Q4

issue_log.handled: Kept as NaN; aggregations skip NaN and a per-customer count of unreported DPD lines is created
issue_log.why: DPD for a Closed line is always 0 in the data, but for Active/Written-Off lines the true value is unknown; filling with 0 would understate risk, filling with the mean would invent delinquency
issue_log.impact: Customer-level max/mean DPD are computed over reported lines only; a 'dpd_unreported_lines' feature carries the gap

issue_log.found: 11243 nulls, all on Active lines (structural, not a quality issue)
issue_log.why: Null means still open; consistent with account_status

issue_log.handled: Set to NaT and flagged; account_status kept as 'Closed'/'Written-Off'
issue_log.why: No line was opened after 2025-12-29, so a closure in 2026-2029 cannot be an observed event; the status label is still informative, the date is not
issue_log.impact: Closure date is not used as a feature; 'time since closure' features are therefore not built

issue_log.found: Opened dates run 2018-2025 and are independent of the customer's loan origination dates (≈57% of lines open after the customer's latest loan)
issue_log.handled: Treated as a current snapshot for the primary model; a time-filtered sensitivity model is also trained
issue_log.why: The table has no 'as-of' date, so true point-in-time reconstruction is impossible
issue_log.impact: Main leakage risk — see assumption A3

issue_log.found: 0 overpayments, 0 status-vs-DPD contradictions, 0 missing values, exactly 12 months per account, max DPD 89
issue_log.handled: No change needed; validated that Missed ⇔ emi_paid=0 and On-Time ⇔ DPD=0
issue_log.impact: None. The 12-month window with DPD<90 defines the observation window (A1)

issue_log.found: 3875 of 8635 events (45%) are dated before the loan was originated
issue_log.handled: Kept and flagged; collections data is used for portfolio analytics and the account view only, and is excluded from the default model
issue_log.why: A collections action cannot precede the loan; the date field is unreliable, and collections activity is in any case a consequence of delinquency (post-decision information) rather than a predictor available at the prediction point
issue_log.impact: The model does not benefit from collections signal; analytics on collections intensity are presented without a time dimension
